summary: Petition to the Central Elections Committee concerning the Aug. 30 Damon women's-prison campaign video remains unresolved on the merits; separate reporting about an AI prisoner campaign video does not supply a ruling.
notes: Freshness recheck through Sep. 6 again recovered the PCATI complaint and reporting on the Damon video, plus secondary reporting on a separate AI prisoner campaign video, but no final CEC merits disposition on either matter. The June 19 ruling on a different Ben-Gvir flotilla video remains non-transferable. Preserve allegations as allegations; publication/deletion of campaign media is not itself a legal finding.
